name: Poster
css: .popover, .popover.sheet { box-shadow: var(--docent-shadow); } .popover .arrow { border-color: var(--docent-fg) !important; border-width: 2.5px !important; border-radius: 0 !important; } :host([data-ring='solid']) .ring { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px currentColor; } .title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .eyebrow { align-self: flex-start; padding: 3px 6px; background: oklch(72% 0.2 350); color: var(--docent-fg); font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--docent-fg); margin-bottom: 4px; } .body { color: var(--docent-fg); } .count { color: var(--docent-fg); font-weight: 700; } .button, .popover.stories [part~='button-next'] { border-radius: 0; font-weight: 700; } .button.primary, .button.primary:hover { background: var(--docent-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--docent-fg), 3px 3px 0 2px var(--docent-fg); transition: translate 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out; } .button.primary:hover { translate: -1px -1px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--docent-fg), 4px 4px 0 2px var(--docent-fg); } .button.primary:active { scale: 1; translate: 3px 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--docent-fg); } .close { border-radius: 0; color: var(--docent-fg); } .close:hover { background: var(--docent-accent); }
